Name: Sticky Hold
Effect: This Pokémon's Held Item cannot be removed, stolen or swapped by Moves or Abilities. Additionally, if it's not Holding an Item, Roll 1 Chance Dice when it or the Foe use a Contact Move, to steal the Foe's Held Item.
Description: This Pokémon's body is always oozing adhesive substances, if something gets glued, it will be very difficult to remove.
